name: Health Reminder Tracker
postCreateCommand: pip install --user -r backend/requirements-dev.txt -r frontend/requirements.txt && cd backend && python -m app.seed
postAttachCommand: (cd backend && uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000 &) && cd frontend && API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8000 streamlit run streamlit_app.py --server.headless true
